main_pretraining.repetition_policy: No automatic repetition. Any repeated source needs declared unique tokens, exposure, passes and revised freeze.
main_pretraining.synthetic_shortfall_policy: Do not count held/rejected records or invent an undocumented join. Re-freeze within-domain natural/refined allocations or reduce horizon after measuring supply; no silent replacement.
main_pretraining.checkpoint_policy: Retain continuation and endpoint checkpoints. Treat 100B as a budget-fit scenario or intermediate checkpoint, not an automatic final horizon; freeze a continuation-compatible schedule before launch.
main_pretraining.target_status: desired flagship scale; hardware, eligible supply and funding not yet qualified
main_pretraining.horizon_scope: Combined pretraining and capability mid-training exposure. Initial bank totals assume the starting mixture; revise aggregate exposures when a staged mixture is frozen.

capability_continuation.purpose: Targeted code/math/repair learning with broad-data replay
capability_continuation.budget_ownership: A portion of main_pretraining target_tokens and the main_pretraining GPU-hour reservation; no additional allowance
capability_continuation.data_recipe: Qualify task difficulty, source families, independent correctness, overlap/replay and language/task coverage; mixture and replay share remain unfrozen
capability_continuation.objective: Existing next-token objective initially; any masked repair objective requires an explicit qualified adapter
capability_continuation.runtime_boundary: Predeclared mixture phases exist; a dedicated changed-data checkpoint continuation contract remains to implement and qualify. Do not use a context-extension label for a data intervention.

mid_training.context_extension: See context_extension for the separate additional exposure, length curriculum and budget; keep capability and length effects distinct

context_extension.boundary: Proposed stage token counts include short replay. Each maximum is a ceiling, not a fixed padded length. Measure length-bucket costs and useful context; no long-context throughput has been established. Source overlap/replay with base must be disclosed.
context_extension.mixture_control: Compare unchanged preceding-stage domain weights repacked into coherent longer records against the proposed long-material/replay weights; neither has been validated for Speck.
evaluation_additions: Held-out fixed-suffix NLL with increasing related prefix length
Retrieval/QA stratified by answer position and distractor distance
Existing short-task retention and multi-file repair

post_training.counting: Deduplicate tasks/source families; assign each conversation one primary category. Agentic coding counts in agent category, not twice. Held-outs excluded from target. Row shares are acquisition targets, not final token sampling weights. Conversation quotas describe SFT only; RL task and rollout inventories are separate.
post_training.length_policy: Keep complete examples across <=4K, 4-16K, 16-32K, 32-128K; preserve over-target records separately. Reacquire upstream long tails omitted from existing stock.
post_training.boundary: 4K-rate scenarios omit variable padding, long attention cost, evaluation, teacher generation, verification and retries. The 800-hour reservation covers SFT and any on-allocation teacher/verification/preference/RL work; additions must fit or displace work. No multi-epoch commitment.

stage_design.sft: Length-bucketed assistant-masked thinking and tool supervision; shorter qualified buckets first, then mixed short and long examples through the validated context ceiling. One unique-task inventory, explicit exposure and replay accounting.
stage_design.rl: Proposed bounded GRPO-style verifiable-reward training after a useful SFT baseline; qualify implementation, rollout engine, task verifiers and recovery first. No qualified RL trainer currently exists in the repo.
stage_design.rl_initial_scope: Checkable math and sandboxed code tasks; proposed initial total context ceiling 16K, then 32K only if useful and affordable. Output and tool-step caps frozen separately. Agent/environment RL conditional on reliable executable tasks.
stage_design.rl_cost_boundary: Charge rollout generation, reference-policy/scoring passes, updates, evaluation, retries and allocated idle GPUs. CPU sandbox costs recorded separately; no 128K RL commitment.
stage_design.release_selection: Retain base and SFT checkpoints. Promote RL checkpoint only for measured gains without unacceptable regressions; otherwise release the SFT thinking assistant.

main_scenarios.role: budget-fit scenario, not revised flagship target

compute.boundary: H100 measured full-trainer rate includes startup, validation and saves, not setup, external capability evaluation, transfer/idle or provider billing. No GH200/multiworker scaling claim. Effective rate divides aggregate throughput by every allocated GPU. Do not spend protected context/SFT/evaluation budgets on base expansion.
compute.allocation_interpretation: User confirmed 2026-09-19: 5,000 total GPU-hours across four GH200s, equivalent to 1,250 four-GPU elapsed hours. Provider access remains unconfirmed.
compute.scaling_boundary: Illustrative 80% efficiency is not measured. Four GPUs at H100 per-device speed yield 51,437 aggregate tokens/s at perfect scaling or 41,149 at 80%; GPU-hour cost is invariant at perfect scaling and rises with inefficiency. GH200 per-device gains require measurement.
compute.breakdown_status: Planning subdivisions of existing 800h post-training and 889h protected reservations, not measured requirements or launch authorization. If SFT needs more, revise the split before launch; RL remains conditional.

storage.boundary: Token IDs only; indexes, masks, raw text, deduplication databases, checkpoints and backups cost extra. Two-TB scratch is a working allowance, not a measured footprint. Acquisition should be bounded and streamed.
